land.text: the Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei and Yap districts of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands, which the US administered: 'The termination of US administration of the Chuuk, Yap, Kosrae, Pohnpei, and the Mariana Islands districts of the TTPI soon followed on November 3, 1986' (Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands page)

predecessors.note: Chain of rule on the pages: Spain (Santiago de la Ascension founded 1887), sold to Germany in 1899, the Japanese South Seas Mandate, captured by the US in 1944 (the page dates Operation Hailstone, the attack on Truk Lagoon, to February 1944), Trust Territory from 1947. Cliopatria's United States row (1967-2005) still contains Pohnpei, so the US dossier must hand the Trust Territory over in 1986.

capitals.name: Kolonia
capitals.note: 'It was also the former FSM capital before being replaced by Palikir in 1989' (Kolonia page). The page gives no coordinates; the point is placed from the Palikir page ('Palikir is 8 kilometers (5 miles) southwest of Kolonia'). Reviewer fix (review-oc-02-b).

capitals.name: Palikir
capitals.note: 'It was declared the capital of Micronesia in 1989' (Palikir page); coordinates 6°55′N 158°11′E from the FSM infobox. Reviewer fix (review-oc-02-b): the span was 1986-2024.

correction.text: the four states Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei and Kosrae, from independence on 3 November 1986

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's row begins in 1987, but the FSM 'became a sovereign state after attaining independence on November 3, 1986'.

correction.text: 'The four states, from west to east, are Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, and Kosrae'

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's 459 km2 outline (bbox 158.04-158.34E, 6.71-6.97N) is the island of Pohnpei only; the infobox gives 702 km2 for the four states (ratio 0.65, within a factor of two, but the shape is one state). At the gazetteer's grid the four admin-1 units give 5 land cells (Yap 1, Chuuk 1, Pohnpei 2, Kosrae 1) against 2 for the shape. Yap, Chuuk and Kosrae lie far to the west and east of Pohnpei.

correction.text: the four states Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei and Kosrae, as for 1987-2023 (same outline in Cliopatria)

keyframe_review.note: Same outline (Pohnpei only) and area as the 1987 shape; same correction.

region.text: the Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei and Yap districts of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands

ledger.note: 1986: the Federated States of Micronesia becomes a sovereign state in free association with the United States. The FSM 'became a sovereign state after attaining independence on November 3, 1986'; the Compact of Free Association 'entered into force on November 3, 1986'. The 1979 constitution (ratified May 10, 1979) preceded it; the UN ended the trusteeship under Resolution 683 (22 December 1990 on the Trust Territory page) and admitted the FSM on 9 August 1991.

certainty.note: Island coasts of four widely separated states; maritime limits are not drawn. The only territorial sentence on the page is a historical curiosity about Kapingamarangi and Spain, which 'has made no modern claims'.

notes: Cliopatria rows. The Micronesia row starts 1987 although independence was 3 November 1986 (keyframe added); its outline is Pohnpei alone, so all three shapes are corrected to the four states. Cliopatria's Wikipedia and Wikidata fields ('Micronesia', Q3359409) point at the region, not the state; identity.wikipedia is the state's article and the wikidata value is kept as Cliopatria gives it (Wikidata is unreachable, so it could not be checked), the site should look the state's id up. Cliopatria's United States row 1967-2005 contains Pohnpei (gazetteer intersect), so the US dossier (am-07) should end the Trust Territory in 1986; the Compact of Free Association is not drawn as territory or vassalage here (the FSM is a sovereign state; the US dossier decides whether to tint it). The Trust Territory page dates the trusteeship 18 July 1947 (Resolution 21); the FSM page says 2 April 1947. Not on the pages first opened: the date of the move of the national capital to Palikir (reviewer, review-oc-02-b: the Palikir page gives 1989 and the Kolonia page calls Kolonia the former FSM capital, so capitals are Kolonia 1986-1988 and Palikir from 1989), Yap and Chuuk boundary data. No wars: Operation Hailstone (February 1944) is pre-state. Needed: Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands (1947-1994, suggested slug trust-territory-of-the-pacific-islands) and the Japanese South Seas Mandate (1920-1945) from oc-02-x.
